    Chernobyl

    Leave No One Behind (Никого не оставим)

    Seven chapters, April to November 1986. You will be the people who were there: an engineer in the control room, a wife in Pripyat, a helicopter pilot, a man in the flooded basement, a soldier on the roof, a crane operator. You know how this night ends. This time, you decide.

    Headphones recommended. The Geiger counter is your eyes.
    Narration and score play after your first click.
